items.headline: Sources: Eagles mull Lane Johnson roster status amid O-line changes
items.description: Lane Johnson is expected to remain on the Eagles' 53-man roster until after June 1 for salary cap purposes as Philadelphia continues to navigate multiple changes to the offensice line.

items.headline: Eagles vs. Jaguars, NFL London preview: ESPN experts on key players, matchups and predictions
items.description: The NFL rolls into London this begin with a clash between the Indianapolis Colts and the Washington Commanders -- so we asked ESPN reporters Stephen Holder and John Keim for a preview.

items.headline: Sources: Ravens held Cam Jurgens physical before trade with Eagles
items.description: As the Ravens and Eagles were preparing to agree to a trade that would send Cam Jurgens to Baltimore, the two sides made immediate plans for the center to undergo a physical in Philadelphia before any deal was finalized, league sources told ESPN.

items.headline: Eagles will be tested against the Jaguars
items.description: After losing Lane Johnson and Cam Jergens, Philadelphia heads to London to face Jacksonville with no Saquon Barkley or DaVonta Smith.

items.headline: Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith among 5 Eagles ruled out vs. Jags
items.description: Eagles running back Saquon Barkley, wide receiver DeVonta Smith, new starting center Drew Kendall, safety Marcus Epps and wide receiver Hollywood Brown were all ruled out for Sunday's game in London against the Jaguars.
